title: 818. Short Encoding of Words

examples.explanation: The string "time#bell#" holds every word as a #-terminated suffix and has length 10.
me is already a suffix of time, so "time#" alone suffices.

hints: A word that appears as the tail of a longer word never needs its own #-block.
Collect distinct words in a set, delete every proper suffix of every word, then sum length+1 over survivors.
